description: No defined processes for user identification and authentication.
applicability: This signal applies to: Organizations processing, storing, or transmitting cardholder data Identity and access management systems User directories and authentication services Administrative access to CDE components Remote access to payment systems

related_controls: 8.1 Processes and mechanisms for identifying and authenticating users are defined and understood.
metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Review documentation for formal authentication and identification processes. Look for defined user provisioning workflows, authentication method standards, and account lifecycle management procedures. Absence of documented processes for managing user identities and authentication indicates this signal.
